summary: Tested special-task 'new task' notifications end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest pass (one initial failure was a test-filter bug: special_task_reward notifs share meta.task_id; fixed in the test). Force-activate -> exactly 1337 special_task_new notifs (= all users minus creator, banned TEST user excluded, no per-user duplicates), second call 400 and no duplicates after a watcher tick; DB flip pending_payment->active picked up by the watcher within ~20s with 1337 notifs, never duplicated; backfilled tasks have 0 special_task_new notifs. Availability endpoint verified for active/draft/pending_payment/unknown/completed/full/paused/own/done/no-auth. Frontend (mobile 390x844): testactif /notifications list shows the notifs; tapping goes to /tasks-more?task=<id> with task-focus-available and the st-card border at 2px #7B61FF; a task set to completed in DB shows task-focus-unavailable 'Toutes les places de cette tâche ont été prises.' and is not listed; /tasks-more without ?task shows no banner; a notification without a link marks read on tap and stays on /notifications; a live toast appeared ~4s after a force-activate on the dashboard, and tapping notif-toast-open-<id> navigated to the focused task; the pending user filleul.attente is redirected to /pay for /notifications and for the deep link.

minor.issue: Inserting ~1.3k notifications plus push_to_all_registered runs inside the request. Fast now (no push tokens), but it will get slow once there are many FCM tokens. Consider asyncio.create_task or leaving it to the watcher.
An active task with quantity_target 0 or missing is reported as 'completed' (0 >= 0). Edge case only.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing: when the unread count grows, the toaster shows the top unread items (MAX_STACK=2), not just the new one. An older unread special_task_new notif was toasted again next to the fresh one (2 identical-looking toasts).
Tapping a toast navigates but does not mark the notification read; the bell badge stays.

issues: The highlighted card is not scrolled into view or moved to the top. With 35 tasks the focused card sits far below, even though the banner says 'retrouvez-la en surbrillance ci-dessous'. Suggest sorting the focused task first or scrollTo on its layout.

action_items: Optional: put the focused task first, or auto-scroll to it, on /tasks-more?task=<id>
Optional: toast only notification ids that were not in the previous list; mark read when a toast is tapped
Restore the tasks activated during testing if needed (see other.activated_task_ids)
critical_code_review_comments: notify_new_special_task: the atomic claim via notified_at is correct and prevents duplicates across force-activate and the watcher.
If insert_many fails partway after the claim, the task is never retried (notified_at already set). Acceptable, but consider logging or storing notified_count.
useNotificationsFeed shows 'latest' = unread list, not a diff (see ui_bugs).
